result.title: Criteria-led discharge and length of stay in a hospital: an interrupted time series
result.abstractText: In a 400-bed hospital, criteria-led discharge reduced mean length of stay from 6.1 to 5.6 days (difference -0.5 days, 95% CI -0.8 to -0.2). Discharges before noon rose from 12% to 21%.
